patch_description: The velocity clamp bounds per-step displacement but still permits alternating ±limit steps, which is how ~20 slope changes survive as bounded oscillation. Add a zero-phase curvature clamp on the second difference |y[k+1] - 2y[k] + y[k-1]| ≤ c * (robust d2 scale), applied in forward+backward sweeps with the same slack-doubling retry pattern (corr ≥ 0.97) used by the velocity clamp. This bounds the oscillation rate of the derivative without adding lag or shifting the signal level.
